- Fix various visual bug

notes.title: Demo Update and Cerebral showcase
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just a quick announcement, as part of the Cerebral puzzle showcase There's a news demo available for you to try, the demo includes :


 New puzzles
 New sound design
 Full controller support
 Full steam deck support
 Level title
 some graphical improvements


I'm also happy to announce that the game will release in 2024 so hang tight, you will soon be able to play the full game.

Thanks you !
